current.description:
Current page number.

Represents the current page being requested in paginated responses. This value must be a non-negative integer starting from 0 for the first page.

This property enables clients to specify which page of results they want to retrieve from the economic discussion board API.

pages.description:
Total pages.

Represents the total number of pages available based on the total record count and the page size limit. Calculated as the ceiling of total records divided by the current limit per page.

This computed value is returned by the economic discussion board API to help clients understand the full pagination scope of their request.

limit.description:
Limitation of records per a page.

Defines the maximum number of records to be returned in a single paginated response. This value determines how many economic discussion board entities (such as articles, comments, or members) will be included in each page of results.

The limit helps optimize API performance and manage client-side memory usage when dealing with large datasets.

records.description:
Total records in the database.

Represents the complete count of all matching records in the economic discussion board database system, regardless of pagination settings.

This total count enables clients to calculate pagination math and understand the full scope of available data in the economic discussion platform.

IPage.IPagination.description:
Structured page information with proper interface naming.

Represents comprehensive pagination metadata returned by the Economic/Political Discussion Board platform. This object contains all necessary information for clients to implement seamless pagination experiences.

The pagination structure provides complete context about the current result set, including position within the overall dataset, page boundaries, and total scope. This enables sophisticated pagination interfaces while maintaining efficient API performance for the economic discussion board system.

access.description:
JWT access token for authenticated requests.

This token should be included in the Authorization header for subsequent
authenticated API requests as `Bearer {token}`.

refresh.description:
Refresh token for obtaining new access tokens.

This token can be used to request new access tokens when the current access
token expires, extending the user's session.

expired_at.description:
Access token expiration timestamp.

ISO 8601 date-time string indicating when the access token will expire and
can no longer be used for authentication.

refreshable_until.description:
Refresh token expiration timestamp.

ISO 8601 date-time string indicating the latest time until which the
refresh token can be used to obtain new access tokens.

IAuthorizationToken.description:
Authorization token response structure.

This interface defines the structure of the authorization token response
returned after successful user authentication. It contains both access and
refresh tokens along with their expiration information.

This token structure is automatically included in API schemas when the system
detects authorization actors in the requirements analysis phase. It provides
a standard format for JWT-based authentication across the generated backend
applications.

IEconomicDiscussionGuest.ICreate.description:
Data required to create a new guest session for browsing access to the Economic Discussion Board.

This schema represents the minimal information needed to establish a temporary guest browsing session. Guests are anonymous visitors who can read content without registration. The system tracks their activity for analytics and download limits while respecting their privacy by not requiring personal information.

Guest sessions enable the platform to serve content to unregistered users while maintaining session integrity and usage tracking. The user_agent field helps with session identification and browser capability detection for optimal content delivery.

id.description: Primary Key. Unique identifier for the newly created guest session returned after successful authorization.

username.description: Guest display name returned in authorization response for immediate session identification.

created_at.description: Guest session creation timestamp returned after successful authorization process.

last_activity_at.description: Initial activity timestamp for the new guest session upon successful authorization.

articles_viewed_count.description: Initial article view count (0) for new guest sessions to track future activity.

downloads_count.description: Initial download count (0) for new guest sessions to track future resource usage.

IEconomicDiscussionGuest.IAuthorized.description:
Complete guest authorization response providing session information and secure access token context.

This schema represents the authenticated guest session data returned after successful session creation or guest join operations. It provides all necessary information for the client to maintain session state and for the platform to track guest activity without exposing sensitive authentication details.

The authorized response enables the frontend to immediately display guest information and track session age while allowing the backend to maintain activity counters and enforce download limits. This balances user experience with platform security and resource management.

id.description: Guest session identifier for refresh operations to extend session duration and update activity tracking.

IEconomicDiscussionGuest.IRefresh.description:
Guest refresh request to extend temporary browsing session without requiring authentication.

This schema represents the minimal data needed to refresh a guest browsing session. Guest sessions expire after extended inactivity periods, and this refresh mechanism allows the platform to maintain continuity for active guests without forcing them to restart their browsing experience.

The refresh operation updates session timestamps and activity tracking while preserving the guest's current session state including their activity counters and browsing history. This ensures seamless content access for irregular users while helping maintain accurate session analytics.

IEconomicDiscussionMember.ICreate.description:
Data required for member registration and account creation.

This DTO captures all necessary information for new member signup including authentication credentials, profile information, and security measures for the economic discussion board community participation system.

username.description: Chosen display name for community participation. Between 3-30 characters with letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens only. Must be unique across all members for consistent community identity and clean URL generation.

email.description: Email address for account authentication and notifications. Must be unique across all members to prevent duplicate accounts and ensure reliable communication channels.

password.description: Secure password for account authentication. Minimum 8 characters required for adequate security in financial and political discussion environment where member identity protection is crucial.

email_verified.description: Initial email verification status. Typically false for new registrations until email verification process is completed to ensure valid contact information and prevent spam accounts.

IEconomicDiscussionMember.ILogin.description:
Member login credentials for authentication.

This DTO captures the essential authentication credentials required for member login to the economic discussion platform. It handles secure credential validation and session initialization for community access.

The login process validates the email address against the member database and verifies the provided password hash against stored credentials. Successful authentication results in session creation and token generation for subsequent API access.

Used during the member authentication process to verify identity and establish secure sessions for accessing protected community features like article creation, commenting, and profile management.

email.description:
Email address for member authentication.
Must match a registered member email and follow standard email format validation.

password_hash.description:
Encrypted authentication credential for login verification.
Required to authenticate member account and establish secure session.

IEconomicDiscussionMember.IAuthorized.description:
Member authentication response with access tokens and profile data.

This DTO provides complete authentication response including secure access tokens and member profile information after successful login. It enables immediate client-side state management and subsequent authenticated API operations.

The response includes JWT access tokens for API authentication, refresh tokens for session renewal, and essential member profile data for UI state management. Tokens are formatted for standard Bearer authentication patterns and include appropriate expiration information.

Used as the response structure for member login operations, providing both authentication credentials and user context needed for platform functionality.

member.description:
Authenticated member summary information.
Provides essential profile data for client-side state management and UI display.

access_token.description:
JWT access token for authenticated API operations.
Used in Authorization header for secure resource access and operation authorization.

refresh_token.description:
Refresh token for session renewal when access tokens expire.
Enables seamless session continuation without re-authentication.

expires_in.description:
Access token expiration time in seconds.
Indicates how long the access token remains valid before requiring renewal.

IEconomicDiscussionMember.IRefresh.description:
Token refresh request for extending member sessions.

This DTO handles token renewal when access tokens expire but refresh tokens remain valid. It enables seamless session continuation without requiring member re-authentication.

The refresh process validates the provided refresh token against active sessions and issues new access tokens with extended expiration. This maintains secure API access while providing good user experience for extended platform usage.

Used for background token renewal to prevent authentication interruptions during active platform usage, ensuring members can continue their economic and political discussion activities without manual re-login.

refresh_token.description:
Valid refresh token for session renewal.
Must correspond to an active member session for successful token generation.

email.description: Administrator email address for secure communications and account recovery. Must be a valid email format for system notifications and administrative correspondence.

password_hash.description: Advanced authentication credential with enhanced security. Encrypted password hash used for moderator login authentication and access control.

email_verified.description: Verification status for administrative account security. Indicates whether the moderator's email address has been confirmed through the verification process.

two_factor_enabled.description: Two-factor authentication requirement for moderator access. Enables additional security layer requiring secondary authentication method for administrative operations.

moderation_level.description: Authorization level for different moderation scopes. Defines the moderator's permission tier within the administrative hierarchy of the discussion board platform.

IEconomicDiscussionModerator.ICreate.description:
Data required for moderator account creation and administrative access setup.

Essential information needed to establish a new moderator account with appropriate permissions for economic and political discussion board administration. Includes security credentials, contact information, and initial permission configuration required for successful moderator onboarding and platform access authorization.

username.description:
Moderator username for authentication credentials.

This field serves as the primary identifier for moderator account access within the Economic Discussion platform. The username must be unique across all moderator accounts and follows standard security practices for administrative credentials.

Validation requirements ensure usernames are between 3-50 characters to balance security with usability. This range prevents overly simple usernames while maintaining reasonable length for memorability in administrative workflows.

The username links directly to the economic_discussion_moderators table and serves as a foreign key reference for session management, audit trails, and administrative activity tracking throughout the platform.

password.description:
Password for authentication. Plain text for verification during the login process.

This field accepts the moderator's password in plain text format for server-side verification against stored hash values. The system implements secure password handling with proper hashing algorithms before database storage.

The password field supports complex authentication including special characters, mixed case, and numeric requirements as defined by system security policies. Password complexity requirements are enforced during account creation and can be configured through system settings.

Moderator passwords require enhanced security due to elevated administrative privileges, necessitating regular updates and complexity requirements beyond standard user accounts.

oneOf.description: Client IP address for session tracking and security monitoring.

ip.description:
Client IP address for session tracking and security monitoring.

This optional field captures the network location of the authentication attempt for security audit trails and session management. The IP address enables geographic verification, suspicious activity detection, and administrative access monitoring.

Server-side extraction provides the primary IP detection mechanism, but client-side provision supports various deployment scenarios including proxy configurations, load-balanced environments, and SSR implementations where direct IP extraction may be complex.

IP tracking is essential for moderator account security given elevated privileges, enabling multi-factor authentication decisions and unauthorized access detection through geographic anomaly identification.

href.description:
Connection URL (current page URL) for session context tracking.

This field captures the exact URL context where the authentication request originated, providing essential metadata for session creation, audit trails, and administrative activity monitoring. The href enables comprehensive session tracking across different application contexts and user interfaces.

The URI format ensures proper validation of connection contexts while supporting various deployment scenarios including single-page applications, server-side rendered interfaces, and mobile application contexts. This flexibility enables consistent audit trail generation across diverse client implementations.

Session context tracking through href monitoring enables security analysis of authentication patterns, helping identify potential unauthorized access attempts or unusual administrative behavior patterns that may require investigation.

referrer.description:
Referrer URL (previous page URL) for navigation tracking and security audit.

This field captures the navigation path leading to the authentication request, providing crucial context for understanding user behavior patterns and identifying potential security anomalies in administrative access workflows.

The referrer information enables comprehensive audit trail generation by linking authentication events to specific application workflows and user navigation sequences. This context is particularly valuable for moderator accounts given their elevated administrative privileges and access to sensitive platform functions.

Navigation tracking through referrer monitoring supports security incident investigation by providing complete contextual information about authentication attempts, helping distinguish between legitimate administrative access and potential unauthorized activities requiring moderator intervention.

IEconomicDiscussionModerator.ILogin.description:
Login credentials for moderator authentication with administrative access to the Economic Discussion platform.

This interface provides comprehensive authentication data for moderator sign-in operations, combining standard credential validation with advanced security tracking and session context management. The structure supports robust authentication flows while maintaining the clean, simple patterns appropriate for discussion board implementations.

The interface balances security requirements with operational simplicity, providing essential audit trail capabilities through session context fields while maintaining straightforward authentication workflows. This design enables secure administrative access monitoring without overwhelming the authentication process with excessive complexity.

Usage encompasses all moderator authentication scenarios including initial login, session renewal, and administrative tool access, providing consistent security tracking across diverse authentication contexts within the Economic Discussion platform.

id.description: Unique identifier of the authenticated moderator. Links to the economic_discussion_moderators table primary key field for session management and administrative activity tracking throughout the platform.

username.description: Moderator username for display and identification in administrative interfaces. Matches the username field from the moderator's profile for consistent attribution across all moderation activities and user interfaces.

email.description: Verified email address associated with the moderator account. Used for secure communications, account recovery, and administrative notifications requiring moderator attention.

email_verified.description:
Email verification status for administrative account security and operational integrity.

This boolean field indicates whether the moderator's email address has been verified through the platform's confirmation workflow. Email verification is mandatory for moderator accounts to ensure accountability, enable secure communications, and maintain administrative access traceability.

Verified email addresses are essential for moderator operations as they enable secure password recovery, administrative notifications, and emergency communications regarding platform issues or policy violations requiring immediate moderator attention.

The verification status directly impacts moderator functionality, with unverified accounts maintaining limited privileges until confirmation is completed. This security measure prevents unauthorized administrative access and ensures all moderators can receive critical platform communications through verified channels.

two_factor_enabled.description:
Current status of two-factor authentication requirement for the moderator account for enhanced security protection.

This field indicates whether two-factor authentication is currently active for the moderator account, providing an additional security layer beyond standard password authentication. Two-factor authentication significantly enhances account security by requiring secondary verification through trusted devices or authentication applications.

Administrative accounts with elevated privileges benefit from mandatory two-factor authentication to prevent unauthorized access to sensitive moderation tools, user management functions, and system configuration capabilities that could impact the entire discussion platform.

The status affects all subsequent administrative operations, with enabled accounts requiring additional verification steps for sensitive actions. This security measure protects against credential compromise and ensures only authorized personnel can access critical platform administrative functions.

moderation_level.description:
Authorization level determining the scope of administrative capabilities and moderation permissions within the Economic Discussion platform.

This field defines the hierarchical permission structure for moderator accounts, controlling access to different moderation tools, system settings, and administrative functions based on assigned responsibility levels and organizational requirements.

The moderation level directly impacts which platform features and user management capabilities are available to the authenticated moderator, enabling granular permission control that aligns with community governance structures and administrative delegation requirements.

Authorization levels support role-based access control for discussion board management, ensuring moderators receive appropriate access to community moderation tools while maintaining security boundaries between different administrative responsibilities and organizational roles within the platform.

created_at.description: Moderator appointment timestamp indicating when the administrative account was initially created and granted platform access privileges.

updated_at.description: Last access timestamp for activity monitoring and session management within administrative interfaces.

IEconomicDiscussionModerator.IAuthorized.description:
Moderator authentication response containing session tokens and comprehensive moderator metadata for administrative access.

This response provides the complete authentication state including access and refresh tokens, detailed user profile information, and current authorization configuration. The comprehensive response structure enables immediate administrative functionality while maintaining session security through industry-standard JWT implementation.

The response includes essential administrative metadata such as moderator permissions, security settings, and session information that helps client applications understand the authenticated administrative context. This metadata is crucial for building appropriate administrative interfaces and handling authorization workflows in economic discussion management scenarios.

The interface supports all moderator authentication scenarios including initial login, token refresh, and administrative tool access, providing consistent authorization context across diverse authentication flows while maintaining the security standards appropriate for administrative account access within the Economic Discussion platform.

referrer.description: Previous page URL for complete session breadcrumb tracking. Enables comprehensive administrative activity monitoring.

IEconomicDiscussionModerator.IRefresh.description:
Moderator token refresh request with session tracking metadata for administrative audit compliance.

Enables seamless continuation of moderator sessions through token renewal while maintaining comprehensive security audit trails. Required metadata supports regulatory compliance and security monitoring for elevated administrative privileges.

IEconomicDiscussionSystemSetting.description:

System settings provide administrators with centralized control over critical platform functions including posting limits, file upload restrictions, user session management, rate limiting, content filtering, and moderation workflows. The configuration system enables flexible platform behavior management without requiring code changes or system restarts, supporting both technical and non-technical administrators through intuitive interfaces and comprehensive documentation.

IEconomicDiscussionGuest.description:
Guest users who can browse and read content without registration in the Economic Discussion Board platform.

Guests have read-only access to articles, comments, and file attachments. They can search and filter content but cannot create, edit, or upload content. Guest sessions are tracked for analytics, download limits, and platform usage monitoring. Each guest session is uniquely identified and monitored to ensure appropriate resource allocation and compliance with platform access policies.

This entity represents anonymous visitors to the discussion board, providing them with temporary access while maintaining session integrity and usage tracking. The guest system enables the platform to serve unregistered users while preserving content quality and platform security through comprehensive activity monitoring and session management.

IEconomicDiscussionGuestSession.description:
Complete representation of an economic discussion guest session for tracking unregistered user activity and browsing patterns. Guest sessions provide analytics capabilities while maintaining privacy protections through limited data collection.

This entity captures essential session metadata including connection details, navigation context, and security information. It serves as the foundation for guest-specific functionality including download limit enforcement, article view tracking, and personalized content delivery.

The session maintains relationships with the parent guest entity while providing independent session lifecycle management. Security considerations include IP-based rate limiting, automatic session expiration, and privacy-compliant data handling that respects guest anonymity preferences while enabling platform analytics and content optimization.

guest_id.description: Associated guest user ID for whom the session is being created. Links the session to the guest entity for tracking and attribution purposes.

ip.description: Session IP address for security and audit purposes. Captures the network location for session tracking and compliance.

href.description: Initial page URL where the guest session begins. Establishes the starting point for browsing activity tracking.

referrer.description: Referrer URL indicating the traffic source that brought the guest to the platform. Provides context about how users discover the discussion board.

IEconomicDiscussionGuestSession.ICreate.description: Session creation payload for establishing new guest browsing sessions. Used when guests first access the economic discussion board to initialize tracking and analytics. Requires core connection details to properly attribute session activity.

id.description: Unique session identifier for targeted updates. Allows updating specific session records when multiple sessions exist for the same guest.

href.description: Current page URL for session tracking. This field updates the connection URL to reflect the latest page visited by the guest user during their browsing session.

referrer.description: Referrer URL indicating the traffic source or previous page that led to the current session. Helps track navigation patterns for analytics and content engagement analysis.

expired_at.description: Session expiration timestamp for automatic cleanup. Updates the session's validity period to maintain security through finite session lifetimes and prevent unauthorized access.

IEconomicDiscussionGuestSession.IUpdate.description: Update payload for guest session activity tracking. This DTO allows refreshing session data when guests navigate through different pages during their browsing session. All fields are optional to support targeted updates without requiring full session data, following RESTful partial update patterns.

id.description: Unique session identifier for tracking and management. Primary key from economic_discussion_guest_sessions table.

economic_discussion_guest_id.description: Associated guest user's unique identifier. Foreign key referencing economic_discussion_guests.id for session ownership verification.

ip.description: Session IP address captured for security verification and audit trail purposes.

href.description: Connection URL representing the current page location for session tracking.

referrer.description: Referrer URL indicating the traffic source or previous page visited by the guest.

created_at.description: Session creation timestamp when the guest session was first established.

expired_at.description: Session expiration time for automatic cleanup and security management. May be null for active sessions.

IEconomicDiscussionGuestSession.IInvert.description:
Guest session viewed from the guest perspective, providing parent guest context for independent session viewing.

This inverted view is useful for displaying "My sessions" type interfaces where users need to see their own session history with complete guest attribution. The guest reference provides the necessary context without requiring additional API calls to fetch guest information.

The IInvert pattern prevents circular references by keeping the guest as a summary reference rather than including full guest detail types that might contain session arrays.

search.description: Text-based search query to filter members by username, email, or other profile information. Enables administrators to quickly locate specific members using partial matches.

exclude_ids.description: List of member IDs to exclude from search results. Useful for filtering out members who are already being processed or should not appear in specific administrative workflows.

email_verified.description: Filter by email verification status. When true, returns only members with verified email addresses. When false, returns only unverified members. When omitted, returns all members regardless of verification status.

created_before.description: Upper boundary for member registration date filtering. Only returns members who registered before this timestamp, useful for finding older accounts or inactive member cohorts.

created_after.description: Lower boundary for member registration date filtering. Only returns members who registered after this timestamp, useful for identifying new members or recent registrations.

last_active_before.description: Upper boundary for member last activity date filtering. Only returns members who were last active before this timestamp, useful for identifying inactive members for cleanup or re-engagement campaigns.

last_active_after.description: Lower boundary for member last activity date filtering. Only returns members who were last active after this timestamp, useful for identifying recently active contributors and engaged community members.

reputation_score_min.description: Minimum reputation score threshold for member filtering. Returns only members with reputation scores at or above this value, useful for identifying high-contribution members or setting privilege thresholds.

reputation_score_max.description: Maximum reputation score threshold for member filtering. Returns only members with reputation scores at or below this value, useful for identifying new members or those requiring support.

sort_by.description: Sorting criterion for result ordering. Options may include 'created_at', 'username', 'email_verified', 'reputation_score', or 'last_active_at' to organize member listings according to administrative needs.

oneOf.description: Sorting direction for member results. 'asc' for ascending order or 'desc' for descending order. Defaults to descending order when not specified to show most recent activity first.
Sorting direction for member results. 'asc' for ascending order or 'desc' for descending order. Defaults to descending order when not specified to show most recent activity first.

order.description: Sorting direction for member results. 'asc' for ascending order or 'desc' for descending order. Defaults to descending order when not specified to show most recent activity first.

page.description: Page number for paginated results starting from 1. Enables administrators to browse through large member bases efficiently using pagination controls.

limit.description: Number of results to return per page. Supports efficient browsing through member lists with flexible page sizing suitable for different administrative interfaces.

IEconomicDiscussionMember.IRequest.description: Comprehensive search criteria and filtering options for Economic Discussion community member discovery and administration. This request enables moderators to locate specific members using advanced filtering, sorting, and pagination capabilities tailored for community management workflows.

id.description: Primary key. Unique identifier for this member.

username.description: Member username for display and attribution. Alphanumeric and underscores only, 3-50 characters. Used throughout the platform for article authorship, comment attribution, and member recognition.

email.description: Member email address for contact and notifications. Must be a valid email format. Used for authentication, password recovery, and system notifications.

IEconomicDiscussionMember.ISummary.description:
Community member summary with essential attribution information for cross-references and display purposes.

Provides lightweight member identification including username and contact information while excluding sensitive profile details, privileges, activity history, and authentication data. Designed for use in article attribution, comment authorship, session management, and other cross-entity reference scenarios where basic member context is needed without full profile exposure.

IEconomicDiscussionMember.description:
Registered community members with full participation privileges.

Members can create articles, post comments, upload files, and access all community features. They undergo email verification and authentication process for community participation across the economic and political discussion platform.

id.description: Unique identifier of the member account. Primary key for member management and system-wide reference across all community activities.

username.description: Unique member display name chosen during registration. Between 3-30 characters with letters, numbers, underscores, and hyphens only for clean URL generation and consistent community identity.

email.description: Email address for authentication and notifications. Must be unique across all members for secure account management and reliable communication.

email_verified.description: Email verification status for account activation. Controls access to community features and helps prevent spam through verified member accounts.

created_at.description: Account registration timestamp. Establishes member join date for community participation tracking and administrative oversight across the economic discussion platform.

updated_at.description: Last profile update timestamp. Tracks when member profile information was last modified for audit trails and recent activity monitoring.

reputation_score.description: Community participation score based on activity. Measures member contribution quality and engagement level within economic and political discussions to indicate community standing.

IEconomicDiscussionMember.IUpdate.description:
Member profile update request data.

Allows members to modify their profile information within the community guidelines and technical constraints. Updates are processed with validation and audit logging.

This DTO enables members to update their display name, email preferences, and other profile attributes while maintaining data integrity and community standards. The update process enforces uniqueness constraints and email format validation.

Used for member-initiated profile modifications with proper permission checks and validation. Updates within this DTO respect the community's content policies and technical requirements.

username.description:
Member display name update between 3-30 characters.
Username must remain unique across all members and follow character restrictions.

email.description:
Updated email address for member account.
Email must be unique across the platform and follow standard email format validation.

password_hash.description:
Updated encrypted authentication credential for secure login.
Allows members to change their password within security guidelines.

IEconomicDiscussionMemberSession.IReques.description:
Search and filtering parameters for member authentication sessions.

Supports comprehensive filtering options including date range queries to help members monitor their account security and identify potential unauthorized access attempts. All parameters are optional to allow flexible search scenarios.

created_at.description: Field to sort results by creation time. Supports chronological ordering of session records for security timeline analysis. Uses database field name directly for query optimization.

expired_at.description: Field to sort results by expiration time or IP address. Supports temporal and network-based sorting for different security analysis approaches. Uses actual database field names for proper query generation.

page.description: Page number for pagination, starting from 1. Used to navigate through large result sets of session records.

limit.description: Number of results per page. Maximum 100 items to prevent excessive data loading while providing sufficient results for session management.

search.description: Optional search term for filtering sessions by IP address or referrer URL. Supports partial matching for security audit investigations.

start_date.description: Start date for date range filtering to isolate sessions from specific time periods. ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ) for consistent temporal filtering cross-platform.

end_date.description: End date for date range filtering to isolate sessions from specific time periods. Must be after start_date if both are specified to maintain logical date range integrity.

oneOf.description: Ascending sort order for chronological viewing from oldest to newest sessions.
Descending sort order for showing most recent sessions first in typical security monitoring workflows.

order_direction.description: Sort direction selection. Ascending for chronological viewing, descending for most recent sessions first to support different security analysis use cases.

IEconomicDiscussionMemberSession.description:
Authentication sessions for community member access.

Member sessions handle login authentication with JWT tokens, refresh tokens, and session management for registered users to access community features. The session maintains security tracking including IP address, connection context, and validation metadata essential for secure community participation.

id.description: Unique identifier of the session record. Primary key for session management and system-wide reference.

member.description: Associated member account providing session ownership context. Transforms raw FK to complete member summary for immediate access to user information, enabling proper session attribution and member-specific operations throughout the authenticated experience.

ip.description: Session IP address for security verification. Captures the member's network location during session creation to enable security monitoring, session validation, and detection of suspicious login attempts from different locations across the platform.

href.description: Login connection URL for context. Records the page where login occurred, providing essential context for session management, security auditing, and understanding the member's authentication journey throughout their community experience.

referrer.description: Referral source for member acquisition tracking. May be null for direct access routes to member registration or when login occurs from bookmarked pages or direct URL entry without referral chain.

created_at.description: Login session creation timestamp. Establishes the exact moment when this authentication session was established, essential for session lifecycle management, security auditing, and establishing authentication chronology.

expired_at.description: JWT token expiration time for session cleanup. May be null for active sessions where cleanup occurs through separate timing mechanisms, or when using session renewal patterns that extend validity without fixed expiration windows.

IEconomicDiscussionMemberSession.ICreate.description:
Request body for creating a new member authentication session during login.

This DTO captures session metadata required when a member successfully authenticates to the Economic Discussion platform. Member context is established via the path parameter `{memberId}`, so this DTO focuses exclusively on session-specific data including security tracking and connection context necessary for proper session management.

href.description: Connection URL (current page URL) - MANDATORY session context field. Represents the destination where the member completed login, providing essential context for session management and security auditing to track the authentication flow completion location.

ip.description: Client IP address for session tracking and security verification. Captures the member's network location at login completion, enabling security monitoring and session validation to help prevent unauthorized access attempts from differing network locations across the platform ecosystem.

referrer.description: Referral source URL (previous page URL) - MANDATORY session context field. Tracks the source that referred the member to the login process completion, providing valuable analytics data for understanding member acquisition patterns and authentication journey tracking across platform engagement touchpoints.

IEconomicDiscussionMemberSession.IUpdate.description:
Request body for updating an existing member authentication session.

This DTO allows refreshing session information while maintaining session integrity. It supports updating security metadata including IP address tracking, referrer information for analytics, and expiration time management for proper session lifecycle handling.

The update process maintains session security by ensuring only legitimate session owners can modify their session data. This includes proper authorization checks using both member ID and session ID in the path parameters.

Session updates are typically used when network environments change, when extending session lifetimes, or when updating security-related metadata for proper session maintenance.

expired_at.description:
Updated expiration time for session management.

This field allows extending the session lifetime or managing session cleanup timing. It supports scenarios where sessions need to be kept active longer than the default expiration period or when implementing custom session lifecycle management.

The timestamp should be in ISO 8601 format for proper date-time handling. A null value can be used to indicate no fixed expiration time, which may be appropriate for long-lived admin sessions or when implementing session renewal mechanisms.

ip.description:
Updated IP address for session tracking.

This field allows updating the member's network location when session IP changes are detected. The IP address update supports proper session verification and helps maintain accurate security tracking throughout the session lifecycle.

The field is optional and accepts null values to handle scenarios where IP detection is unavailable or when clearing previous IP data for privacy reasons. When provided, it should be in standard IPv4 or IPv6 format for proper validation and storage.

referrer.description:
Updated referrer URL for member acquisition tracking.

This field allows updating the referral source information when session context changes or when additional referrer data needs to be captured during the session lifecycle. It helps maintain accurate analytics data for understanding member acquisition patterns.

The URL should be a complete, valid URI when provided. An empty string is also valid to clear previously recorded referrer data, which may be necessary when referrer information becomes irrelevant or outdated.

economic_discussion_member_id.description: Optional updated reference to the associated member account. Allows changing session ownership when administrative updates are needed, though typically remains constant throughout the session lifecycle. Foreign key to economic_discussion_members table maintaining proper relational integrity.

IEconomicDiscussionModerator.IRequest.description:
Request parameters for retrieving filtered and paginated lists of economic discussion board moderators.

These parameters enable moderators and administrators to efficiently search, filter, and navigate the moderation team. The request supports advanced filtering by authentication status, two-factor configuration, and moderation authorization levels.

Search functionality provides fuzzy matching on moderator usernames, while status filters enable administrators to quickly identify moderators requiring attention. Sorting options support various administrative workflows from finding newest moderators to identifying most active administrators.

page.description: Page number for pagination. Default is 1 if not specified. Must be a positive integer starting from 1.

limit.description: Number of items per page. Minimum value is 1 and maximum is 100.

search.description: Search text to filter moderators by username. Supports partial matching with at least 3 characters and maximum 100 characters.

is_email_verified.description: Filter moderators by email verification status. True returns only verified moderators, false returns only unverified moderators, undefined returns all moderators.

two_factor_enabled.description: Filter moderators by two-factor authentication status. True returns only moderators with 2FA enabled, false returns only those without 2FA, undefined returns all moderators.

moderation_level.description: Filter moderators by moderation level. Accepts values: 'junior', 'moderate', 'senior', or 'admin' to find moderators with specific authorization levels.

oneOf.description: Sort results by moderator username alphabetically
Sort results by moderator account creation date
Sort results by last update timestamp
Sort results by authorization level hierarchy

order_by.description: Field to sort the results by. Options include username, creation date, last update, or moderation level.

oneOf.description: Ascending order (A-Z for username, oldest first for dates)
Descending order (Z-A for username, newest first for dates)

order_direction.description: Direction of sorting - ascending or descending. Default is ascending.

username.description: Unique moderator identifier for community management. Can be updated to reflect administrative role changes or username preferences.

email.description: Administrator email address for secure communications. Updateable for administrative contact changes and account recovery purposes.

email_verified.description: Verification status for administrative account security. Can be toggled to reflect email verification workflow completion or re-verification requirements.

two_factor_enabled.description: Two-factor authentication requirement for moderator access. Updateable to enable or disable additional security verification methods.

moderation_level.description: Authorization level for different moderation scopes. Adjustable to reflect promotion, demotion, or role changes within the administrative structure.

IEconomicDiscussionModerator.IUpdate.description:
Update information for moderator account details and permissions through the moderation panel.

Complete set of modifiable fields for administrative moderator management and profile updates. Enables flexible permission adjustments, contact information updates, and security settings modifications while maintaining audit trails for administrative oversight and compliance within the economic discussion board platform.

IEconomicDiscussionModerator.description:
Complete economic discussion board moderator representation for detailed administrative views.

Provides comprehensive moderator information including all authentication and security settings. This detail view is used for administrative panels where complete moderator information is required for management and oversight purposes.

Includes sensitive security information like two-factor authentication status and email verification that should only be accessible to authorized administrators. This detailed view enables complete moderator account management and administrative workflows.

id.description: Primary Key. Unique identifier for the moderator account used across all system references.

username.description: Unique moderator identifier for community management. Used for display and identification purposes across the platform.

email.description: Administrator email address for secure communications. Used for authentication and administrative notifications.

password_hash.description: Advanced authentication credential with enhanced security. Stores the hashed password for secure moderator authentication.

email_verified.description: Verification status for administrative account security. Indicates whether the moderator's email address has been verified for secure access.

two_factor_enabled.description: Two-factor authentication requirement for moderator access. Indicates whether the moderator has enabled 2FA for enhanced security.

moderation_level.description: Authorization level for different moderation scopes. Defines the moderator's permission level and administrative capabilities.

created_at.description: Moderator appointment timestamp. Records when the moderator account was created and administrative access was granted.

updated_at.description: Last access timestamp for activity monitoring. Tracks the most recent moderator activity for administrative oversight and security monitoring.

id.description: Primary key. Unique identifier for this moderator. Essential for administrative references and access control.

username.description: Unique moderator identifier for community management. Display name used for administrative attribution and user identification.

email_verified.description: Verification status for administrative account security. Indicates trusted administrator status for system operations.

two_factor_enabled.description: Two-factor authentication requirement for moderator access. Security indicator for administrative access authorization.

moderation_level.description: Authorization level for different moderation scopes. Permission tier displayed for administrative hierarchy reference.

created_at.description: Moderator appointment timestamp. Indicates when the moderator account was established for administrative tracking.

IEconomicDiscussionModerator.ISummary.description:
Lightweight summary representation of economic discussion board moderators for administrative interfaces and entity references.

Essential moderator identification and status information optimized for administrative dashboards, permission verification, and cross-reference purposes. Provides sufficient detail for administrative decision-making while protecting sensitive credential data and maintaining security boundaries within the economic discussion board platform.

IEconomicDiscussionModeratorSession.description: Complete session details for moderator administrative access including security metadata and audit information. Represents a fully hydrated session record with all tracking information necessary for comprehensive audit logging and security monitoring in the discussion platform's administrative system.

created_at.description: Administrative session creation timestamp for audit trail and session duration tracking.

moderator.description: Associated moderator account providing complete context for session ownership and administrative attribution. Includes essential moderator information for display and authorization verification without exposing sensitive security details.

expired_at.description: Administrative access expiration timestamp for security management and automatic session termination.

href.description: Administrative panel access URL tracked for activity monitoring and session security analysis.

id.description: Unique session identifier for administrative access tracking and audit logging.

ip.description: Administrative session IP address captured for audit requirements and security monitoring.

referrer.description: Referrer source for administrative access monitoring, nullable to handle direct access scenarios.

IEconomicDiscussionModeratorSession.ICre.description:
Request data for creating a new moderator session for administrative access.

This DTO captures session creation context including IP address and administrative access tracking information required for audit purposes. Session context fields (ip, href, referrer) are connection metadata required for session creation and are NOT authentication context fields.

ip.description: Session IP address for security verification and audit logging. Required connection metadata for administrative access tracking - not authentication context.

href.description: Connection URL for session tracking. Required connection metadata to track administrative panel access - cannot be inferred server-side.

referrer.description: Referral source for administrative access monitoring. Optional connection metadata for tracking referrer information - not authentication context.

IEconomicDiscussionModeratorSession.IUpd.description:
Request data for updating an existing moderator session configuration.

Allows moderators to extend their administrative access period while maintaining security audit requirements. All fields are optional to support partial updates.

ip.description: Updated session IP address if changed during session continuation.

href.description: Updated connection URL if administrative panel access point changes.

IEconomicDiscussionArticle.IRequest.description:
Request parameters for searching and filtering economic discussion articles with pagination support.

This request type enables flexible content discovery through various filter combinations including text search, category filtering, author-based filtering, date ranges, and status-based filtering. The system supports both simple keyword searches and complex multi-criteria filters.

Search functionality leverages PostgreSQL GIN indexes for efficient full-text search across article titles and content. Users can combine multiple filter criteria to narrow results or use broad searches for content discovery. Date range filtering enables finding articles within specific time periods.

Pagination is implemented with configurable page sizes and offset-based navigation. Results can be sorted by creation date, view count, title length, or relevance. Sort order can be configured as ascending or descending per user preference.

This request type serves as the foundation for article discovery across the platform, supporting both casual browsing and targeted research needs in economic and political discourse.

IEconomicDiscussionArticle.description:
Complete representation of economic discussion articles with full detail for single entity retrieval.

This DTO provides comprehensive article information including the complete content body, full author details, category assignments, and related entities. It is specifically designed for scenarios where users need the complete article information, typically accessed via GET /articles/{articleId}.

The detail view includes full content, complete author profiles, detailed category information, and all relevant metadata for comprehensive article display and analysis. This schema accurately represents all fields from the economic_discussion_articles Prisma model including soft deletion tracking for moderation workflows.

IEconomicDiscussionArticle.ISummary.description:
Lightweight summary representation of economic discussion articles optimized for list views and brief previews.

This variant provides essential article information for browsing scenarios where loading complete article content would be inefficient. It includes core metadata, author information, and engagement metrics while excluding the full content body and detailed relations.

The summary is particularly useful for article listings, search results, and dashboard displays where users need quick overviews before deciding to view complete articles. It maintains references to authors and categories but uses efficient summary representations.

IEconomicDiscussionArticle.ICreate.description:
Article creation data for new economic and political discussion content with automatic version initialization.

This DTO captures all information needed to establish a new discussion article while ensuring proper moderation workflow and content quality standards. The system enforces content length requirements and supports categorization for optimal content organization and discoverability.

Article creation includes automatic attribution to the authenticated member or moderator, version initialization starting at 1.0, and status assignment to begin the moderation workflow for community standards compliance. The version field is automatically managed by the system during creation.

title.description: Article title introducing the main discussion topic or question

content.description: Comprehensive article content with economic analysis and political discussion

category_ids.description: Selected category IDs for content organization (multiple categories supported)

attachments.description: Optional file attachments supporting the article arguments

id.description: Unique identifier for the category. Primary key for internal system operations.

code.description: Unique category code used for identification and URL generation. Essential for API operations and frontend routing.

name.description: Display name for the category shown to users. Human-readable title used in navigation and selection interfaces.

display_order.description: Display order position for category listing in user interfaces. Lower values appear first in sorted lists.

is_active.description: Current active status determining category availability for new article creation.

article_count.description: Cached article count for performance optimization. Displayed in category listings to show content volume.

IEconomicDiscussionCategory.ISummary.description:
Lightweight summary representation of discussion categories for content organization and navigation.

Provides essential category information optimized for list displays, dropdown selections, and quick reference scenarios. Includes key metadata like article counts and active status for user interface decisions.

The summary format balances performance with information completeness, excluding detailed descriptions and timestamps that aren't necessary for basic category navigation and selection operations.

IEconomicDiscussionAttachment.ISummary.description:
Lightweight summary representation of file attachments for list displays and references.

Optimized for displaying multiple attachments efficiently in lists and search results. Excludes full article context and scan details while providing essential metadata for preview operations and status indication.

This summary serves as the primary display format for attachment listings, enabling users to quickly overview attached files without loading complete attachment information.

file_type.description: File category classification: image, document, or spreadsheet for appropriate preview handling.

filename.description: Original filename provided during upload for user display and download reference.

id.description: Primary key uniquely identifying this attachment record.

is_scanned.description: Security scanning completion status indicating whether the file has been verified safe for download.

IEconomicDiscussionCategory.description:
Article categories for organizing economic and political discussions.

Categories serve as the primary taxonomy system for content organization within the discussion board. They enable users to filter and find relevant discussions based on topic areas and maintain content discoverability across the platform.

Each category represents a specific field of economic or political discourse, allowing users to browse discussions within their areas of interest. The categories are predefined by the system administrators and remain consistent across the platform to ensure standardized content organization. Categories support soft deletion for historical preservation while maintaining referential integrity with associated articles.

id.description: Unique identifier for the category. Primary key generated automatically using UUID v4 standard for global uniqueness across the platform.

code.description: Unique category code used for identification and URL generation. Must be unique across all categories and URL-safe for SEO-friendly links. Used in API endpoints and navigation structures.

name.description: Display name for the category shown to users in navigation and filters. Should be clear, descriptive, and concise for optimal user experience. Maximum length ensures proper display across all interface contexts.

oneOf.description: Optional detailed description explaining the scope and purpose of this category. Provides context about the types of discussions and content appropriate for this category.

description.description: Optional detailed description explaining the scope and purpose of this category. Supports up to 500 characters for comprehensive category guidance while remaining concise. Null when no description is provided.

display_order.description: Numerical order position for displaying categories in user interfaces and menus. Lower numbers appear first in category listings, allowing administrators to control navigation hierarchy and user browsing experience.

is_active.description: Whether this category is currently active and available for new article creation. Inactive categories are hidden from article creation interfaces while preserving historical associations with existing content.

article_count.description: Cached count of articles in this category for performance optimization. Automatically maintained by the system to avoid expensive real-time counting operations. Reflects total articles including soft-deleted content for historical accuracy.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this category was first created in the system. Uses ISO 8601 format for consistent time representation across all platform services and time zones.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this category was last modified or updated. Automatically updated by the system whenever category properties change, providing audit trail for administrative tracking.

oneOf.description: Soft deletion timestamp when this category was removed from active use through administrative action

deleted_at.description: Soft deletion timestamp when this category was removed from active use. Null when the category remains active and available for content organization. Used for logical deletion to preserve historical data integrity.

id.description: Primary key. Unique identifier for this attachment.

article.description: Associated article information. Provides complete article context including and summary information for display purposes.

file_type.description: File type category: image, document, or spreadsheet.

mime_type.description: MIME type for proper file handling.

is_scanned.description: Whether the file has completed security scanning.

IEconomicDiscussionAttachment.description:
File attachments associated with discussion articles supporting images, documents, and spreadsheets.

Stores file metadata and references for attachments uploaded to articles. Files inherit visibility permissions from their parent article. Supports multiple attachment types with strict size and format validation.

Attachments are automatically removed when the associated article is deleted. All files undergo security scanning before approval. The system supports up to 5 attachments per article with combined size limits.

This request object enables users to browse their viewing history with flexible filtering options including date ranges, sorting preferences, and pagination controls. Search parameters support both filtering by time periods and pagination with configurable limits to optimize server performance and user experience. This DTO enables article authors to refine their analysis, correct factual information, or improve discussion quality while maintaining version history transparency. The system enforces content length requirements and supports incremental updates to minimize disruption while improving content quality.

Updates are permitted only within designated time windows after article creation. Authors can modify title, content, and status (within moderation rules). The operation maintains complete audit trail transparency through automatic version number incrementing and system-generated timestamp capture. Articles undergoing moderation review may have restricted update capabilities.

IEconomicDiscussionSearchHistory.description:

Represents a single search performed by a community member, storing the actual query text and execution timestamp for personalized history retention. This enables users to review their previous searches and quickly return to previously accessed content.

IEconomicDiscussionSearchAnalyticsPerfor.description:
Performance analytics tracking search quality metrics and user interaction patterns for platform-wide search optimization and content discovery improvement.

Represents comprehensive search analytics gathering query performance data, result quality measurements, user satisfaction indicators, and behavioral patterns to optimize the platform's search system. This system enables administrators to understand search effectiveness and improve content discoverability.

The analytics system collects metrics on search frequency, results delivered, user interaction patterns, and click-through rates across all community searches. Performance data helps identify popular topics that need better content coverage and searches that yield poor results requiring content improvements.

Analytics capture both successful searches that lead to engagement and searches that fall short of user expectations, providing actionable insights for platform optimization. The data is aggregated from all user interactions with the search system and processed for trend analysis.

This system supports platform growth by identifying search trends, content gaps, opportunity areas for new content creation, and ways to improve general user experience through better search capabilities and more effective content organization based on actual user search behavior.

ISearchMetricsByCategory.description:
Performance analytics data analyzing search patterns and effectiveness broken down by economic/political content categories to identify optimization opportunities and content strategy improvements.

This analytics structure provides category-specific insights into how users discover content within different topical areas of the economic discussion platform. By segmenting search metrics by category, platform administrators can identify which discussion areas generate the most search activity, understand content discoverability challenges, and optimize category assignment for better user content discovery.

The category-based metrics support strategic content management decisions, helping identify underperforming categories, discover content gaps, and understand user interests within specific economic and political domains. This segmentation enables targeted improvements to search functionality, category organization, and content recommendations for different user interest areas.

category.description: Reference to the associated discussion category for segmented performance analysis. Links search metrics to specific topical areas within the economic discussion board, enabling category-focused analytics and comparison of search behavior across different economic and political subject domains.

totalSearches.description: Total count of search queries executed within this specific category across all users and time periods. Enables comparison of search activity levels across different content categories and identification of the most frequently searched topical areas.

uniqueQueries.description: Count of distinct unique search queries for this category, measuring query diversity. Higher values indicate broader user interests within the category, while lower values may suggest content focus areas or limited category coverage of relevant topics.

averageResultsPerCategoryQuery.description: Average number of search results returned per query within this category. Lower values may indicate content gaps or overly specific queries, while balanced averages suggest good category content coverage and appropriate search result relevance.

categoryEngagementRate.description: Percentage of searches within this category that result in user engagement through meaningful interactions with discovered content. Calculated as (searches leading to clicks, comments, or bookmarks) / (total searches) * 100. Higher rates indicate more effective content discovery and user satisfaction with search results.

The classification system enables intelligent file processing - images support thumbnails and galleries, documents enable inline previews, and spreadsheets provide data visualization capabilities while maintaining platform security standards.

IAttachmentFilename.description:
Original filename from the pre-uploaded file URL attachment. Used for display and file type identification in economic discussion articles.

This metadata field represents the original filename at the time of upload to the external storage service. It does not contain any file data - the actual file content is accessed only through the pre-uploaded URL after successful storage service upload.

Supports standard file extensions with security filtering. Common formats include documents (pdf, doc, docx, txt), images (jpg, jpeg, png, gif), spreadsheets (xls, xlsx, csv), and presentation files (ppt, pptx).

Restricted characters include spaces, forward slashes, question marks, ampersands, hash symbols, angle brackets, pipes, and special system characters to prevent path traversal and injection attacks.

IFileSize.description:
File size in bytes of the pre-uploaded file attachment. Used for storage quota management, download performance optimization, and user experience metrics.

Represents the actual size of the file uploaded to the external storage service, not any temporary local data. Measured in bytes for precision and consistency with industry standards.

Typical attachment sizes range from small text documents (1-100 KB) to medium-sized screenshots (100-2000 KB) to research reports and datasets (up to 50 MB). The 50 MB maximum supports common business documents while maintaining reasonable storage costs and download performance in the HTTPS environment.

Storage quota calculations, bandwidth predictions, and download time estimates all depend on accurate file size tracking for optimal user experience in economic discussion content management.

IEconomicDiscussionSystemSetting.ISummar.description:
Enhanced summary representation of system configuration settings with comprehensive administrative context for management and audit trails on the Economic Discussion Board platform.

This summary view provides essential configuration information with complete administrative attribution and permission context. Optimized for administrative displays with clear categorization, modification history, and role-based access information. The structure maintains security while enabling effective delegation of configuration management responsibilities across the platform.

The enhanced structure supports administrative workflows by showing who can modify settings, when changes were made, and what approval processes are required. This enables distributed administration while maintaining oversight and accountability for critical system configurations.

setting_key.description: Unique identifier key for this system setting. Alphanumeric string used for programmatic access and configuration management. Must be unique across all system settings for reliable identification in automated systems.

setting_value.description: Current value of the system setting as string representation. Can contain serialized data for non-string types such as JSON or numeric values. Maximum 1000 characters to support complex configuration values while maintaining readability and performance.

oneOf.description: String data type classification. Indicates that the setting value should be interpreted and validated as plain text without special case handling. Supports alphanumeric characters and standard string validation.
Integer data type classification. Indicates that the setting value should be parsed as a whole number. Supports mathematical operations and integer validation constraints.
Boolean data type classification. Indicates that the setting value should be interpreted as true/false value. Supports logical operations and boolean validation.
JSON data type classification. Indicates that the setting value contains serialized JSON data. Requires JSON parsing validation and supports complex nested data structures.
Float data type classification. Indicates that the setting value should be parsed as a floating-point number. Supports decimal values and numeric operations.

setting_type.description: Data type classification for validation and parsing. Determines how the setting value should be interpreted and validated for proper system behavior across different setting categories.

display_name.description: Human-readable name for administration interfaces. User-friendly label shown in configuration panels and administrative displays. Limited to 200 characters for interface optimization and readability.

category.description: Logical grouping for administrative organization. Groups related settings together in management interfaces. Helps administrators navigate and manage related configuration options efficiently across the system.

is_system_critical.description: Critical status affecting system operation warnings. Determines whether this setting requires administrator approval before modification or if it impacts system stability. Used for safety warnings and access control on critical system components.

modification_history.description: Historical record of setting modifications. Contains recent changes with timestamps and modifier information. Helps track configuration evolution and provides accountability for administrative actions on the Economic Discussion Board platform.

search.description: Optional search term to filter settings by key, display name, or description content

category.description: Optional category filter to limit results to specific configuration groups

Supports flexible querying by search terms, category filtering, critical status flags, and various sorting options. Designed for administrative dashboards and configuration management interfaces that need to display large numbers of settings in organized, searchable formats.

IPageIEconomicDiscussionModeratorSession.description:
A page of moderator session records with complete audit information for security monitoring and administrative access history review.

This pagination wrapper provides comprehensive session tracking data essential for security audits, compliance monitoring, and administrative oversight of moderator platform access. The schema enables review of administrative login patterns, access frequency analysis, and security incident investigation through detailed session metadata including IP addresses, access timestamps, and session expiration tracking.

Business usage includes security compliance audits, access pattern analysis for suspicious activity detection, administrative session monitoring for unauthorized access prevention, and comprehensive activity logging for regulatory requirements. The session data enables administrators to maintain security standards while providing audit trail transparency for administrative actions.

The pagination structure supports efficient navigation through extensive session logs, enabling security teams to investigate incidents, analyze access trends, and maintain comprehensive audit trails for the discussion platform's administrative operations. This is critical for maintaining trust and security in community moderation activities.

IEconomicDiscussionSearchQuery.description:
Search query ranking data containing performance metrics and quality indicators for economic discussion platform analytics and search optimization.

This analytics structure captures user search behavior patterns across the economic discussion board, providing insights into content discovery trends and user engagement with search functionality. The ranking system enables optimization of search results presentation by identifying the most relevant and engaging queries that drive user interaction with economic and political discussion content.

Each ranking entry represents a search query with measurable performance metrics including frequency, engagement scores, and positional rankings. This data supports content strategy decisions, search algorithm improvements, and user experience optimization for the discussion platform. The analytics structure connects search behavior with actual content engagement, helping identify which topics and keywords lead to meaningful user participation in economic discussions.

id.description: Unique identifier for this search query ranking entry. Generated automatically using UUID v4 for tracking individual ranking records and connecting with related analytics systems.

query_text.description: The actual search query text entered by users on the economic discussion platform. Captures user intent for content discovery across economic and political discussions, including topic areas, author names, keywords, and phrase searches.

ranking_position.description: Calculated position rank based on performance metrics including frequency and engagement for sorted display. Lower numbers indicate higher ranking (position 1 = top result), determined through proprietary scoring algorithm combining query frequency and result engagement rates.

frequency.description: Exact count of how many times this search query has been executed across all users on the platform. Represents absolute popularity measure for identifying trending topics and high-interest subject areas within economic discussions.

engagement_score.description: Calculated engagement score combining multiple interaction metrics including click-through rates on search results, time spent on discovered content, and follow-up actions like commenting or bookmarking discovered articles. Higher scores indicate queries that successfully connect users with relevant content.

modified_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this modification occurred. Provides precise timing information for audit tracking and filtering of recent changes.

modified_by.description: Moderator who performed this modification. Shows which administrator or system user made the change for accountability and reference purposes.

change_type.description: Type of modification performed on the setting. Values include 'value_updated', 'category_changed', 'description_modified', 'critical_status_toggled' to categorize different kinds of administrative actions.

previous_value.description: Previous value of the setting before modification. Captures the before state for comparison and rollback purposes if needed.

change_reason.description: Optional reason provided for the modification. Allows administrators to document the rationale for configuration changes to support future troubleshooting and review processes.
